items.title: Mahoutsukai no Yoru
items.description: Set near the end of the Showa period in the late 1980s, an old mansion in Misaki Town is rumored to be the home of a witch. Aoko abruptly enters the world of magi after her grandfather suddenly decides to have Aoko become the Aozaki family's successor. Since then, Aoko moves into the Kuonji Mansion and begins to learn magecraft from the young magus Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. After witnessing the two using magecraft, Soujuurou Shizuki is also forced to live with them until a rune to remove his memories is discovered.
items.title_japanese: 魔法使いの夜
items.description_es: Ambientada cerca del final del período Showa, a finales de la década de 1980, se rumorea que una antigua mansión en la ciudad de Misaki es el hogar de una bruja. Aoko ingresa abruptamente al mundo de los magos después de que su abuelo de repente decide que Aoko se convierta en la sucesora de la familia Aozaki. Desde entonces, Aoko se muda a la Mansión Kuonji y comienza a aprender hechicería de la joven maga Alice Kuonji, la rumoreada bruja de la mansión. Después de presenciar a los dos usando magia, Soujuurou Shizuki también se ve obligado a vivir con ellos hasta que se descubre una runa para eliminar sus recuerdos.

items.title: Kagurabachi
items.description: Young Chihiro spends his days training under his famous swordsmith father. One day he hopes to become a great sword-maker himself. The goofy father and the serious son--they thought these days would last forever. But suddenly, tragedy strikes. A dark day soaked in blood. Chihiro and his blade now live only for revenge.
items.title_japanese: カグラバチ
items.description_es: El joven Chihiro pasa sus días entrenando con su famoso padre herrero. Algún día espera convertirse él mismo en un gran fabricante de espadas. El padre tonto y el hijo serio... pensaron que estos días durarían para siempre. Pero, de repente, sobreviene la tragedia. Un día oscuro empapado de sangre. Chihiro y su espada ahora viven sólo para vengarse.

items.description: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya falls head over heels for an employee at a local CD shop. He's got an air of mystery about him, great style, and an impeccable music taste. Little does she know—this supposedly male employee is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! Mitsuki generally keeps to herself, but since her seat is right next to Aya's, she can't help but be extremely aware of the other's crush. Revealing the truth is out of the question for Mitsuki—but perhaps getting closer to Aya wouldn't be so bad...

items.description_es: Aya, una estudiante de secundaria moderna y alegre, se enamora perdidamente de un empleado de una tienda de CD local. Tiene un aire de misterio, un gran estilo y un gusto musical impecable. Lo que ella no sabe es que este supuesto empleado es en realidad su compañera de clase Mitsuki. Mitsuki generalmente se mantiene reservada, pero como su asiento está justo al lado del de Aya, no puede evitar ser extremadamente consciente del enamoramiento de la otra. Revelar la verdad está fuera de discusión para Mitsuki, pero tal vez acercarse a Aya no sería tan malo...

items.title: Fool Night
items.description: The earth of the distant future is covered in thick clouds, and the sun no longer shines. Plants wither, and oxygen is thin. To fight extinction, humankind has developed a technology that turns humans into plants, providing a small amount of oxygen. Is this process sustainable? Is it ethical? Toshiro Kamiya must consider these questions as he's faced with a difficult choice—save his family or save himself. Kamiya is at the end of his rope. His mother is ill, and his job barely pays for her medication, much less food. With few options left, he considers the life-changing process of floromorphosis. Ready to give his body up for a payday, Kamiya is about to explore the limits of society's waning humanity.
items.title_japanese: フールナイト
items.description_es: La tierra del futuro lejano está cubierta de espesas nubes y el sol ya no brilla. Las plantas se marchitan y el oxígeno es escaso. Para luchar contra la extinción, la humanidad ha desarrollado una tecnología que convierte a los humanos en plantas, proporcionándoles una pequeña cantidad de oxígeno. ¿Es este proceso sostenible? ¿Es ético? Toshiro Kamiya debe considerar estas preguntas mientras se enfrenta a una decisión difícil: salvar a su familia o salvarse a sí mismo. Kamiya está al final de su cuerda. Su madre está enferma y su trabajo apenas le permite pagar sus medicamentos, y mucho menos la comida. Con pocas opciones restantes, considera el proceso de la floromorfosis que cambia la vida. Listo para entregar su cuerpo a cambio de un día de pago, Kamiya está a punto de explorar los límites de la menguante humanidad de la sociedad.

items.title: Sekiro: No Defeat
items.description: The time is Sengoku. Japan is fractured into many independent nations entangled in ceaseless war. At the center lies Ashina, a land of sacred earth and ancient mystery. Two decades after Sword Saint Isshin Ashina reclaimed the region in a brutal coup, a new threat emerges from within: The Interior Ministry. Desperate to protect his homeland, Isshin's grandson Gen'ichirou turns to forbidden powers. The only hope lies in a kidnapped boy—the Divine Heir—and his silent protector: a loyal shinobi known only as Sekiro. This is the story of a lord and his retainer—and their quest to restore balance to a nation on the edge.
items.title_japanese: SEKIRO: NO DEFEAT
items.description_es: El tiempo es Sengoku. Japón está dividido en muchas naciones independientes enredadas en guerras incesantes. En el centro se encuentra Ashina, una tierra de tierra sagrada y misterio antiguo. Dos décadas después de que Sword Saint Isshin Ashina recuperara la región mediante un brutal golpe de estado, surge una nueva amenaza desde dentro: el Ministerio del Interior. Desesperado por proteger su tierra natal, el nieto de Isshin, Gen'ichirou, recurre a poderes prohibidos. La única esperanza reside en un niño secuestrado, el Heredero Divino, y su protector silencioso: un shinobi leal conocido sólo como Sekiro. Esta es la historia de un señor y su vasallo, y su búsqueda para restablecer el equilibrio en una nación al límite.

items.title: Kakunaru Ue wa
items.description: Opposites attract in this hysterical rom-com about two high school manga artists who can’t catch a break! Dweeby high schooler Uehara Yuuki has created the perfect romantic comedy heroine—she’s bashful, airheaded, and completely chaste. When an editor at Uehara’s dream publisher coldly dismisses his manga story as trite and lacking realism, it sends Uehara into a spiral of despair that pushes him into the path of his bubbly, gorgeous classmate, Miyamoto Niina—an aspiring manga artist herself! Having gotten similar feedback on her own manga, Miyamoto proposes she and Uehara engage in a fake relationship, since neither of them have any romantic experience. But Miyamoto is far from the perfect heroine Uehara’s concocted, and he certainly isn’t the cocky hero from her story either. Can their wacky relationship turn their manga dreams into reality, or will it lead to even more comic disasters?
items.title_japanese: 描くなるうえは
items.description_es: ¡Los opuestos se atraen en esta histérica comedia romántica sobre dos artistas de manga de secundaria que no pueden tomar un descanso! Uehara Yuuki, estudiante de secundaria de Dweeby, ha creado la heroína de comedia romántica perfecta: es tímida, cabeza hueca y completamente casta. Cuando un editor de la editorial soñada de Uehara descarta fríamente su historia de manga como trillada y carente de realismo, Uehara cae en una espiral de desesperación que lo empuja al camino de su alegre y hermosa compañera de clase, Miyamoto Niina, ¡una aspirante a artista de manga! Habiendo recibido comentarios similares sobre su propio manga, Miyamoto propone que ella y Uehara entablen una relación falsa, ya que ninguno de los dos tiene ninguna experiencia romántica. Pero Miyamoto está lejos de ser la heroína perfecta que inventó Uehara, y ciertamente tampoco es el héroe engreído de su historia. ¿Podrá su extraña relación convertir sus sueños de manga en realidad o conducirá a más desastres cómicos?

On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured? items.title: Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun
items.description: Momose has always longed for a peaceful high school life. She wants nothing to do with hoodlums, delinquents, or troublemakers. When she meets Ichikura, an inconspicuous black-haired boy with glasses, he looks like a normal, nice guy. But it turns out that back in junior high he was a nefarious delinquent! He keeps assuring her that he’s changed his ways, but he still has a knack for picking fights! Has Ichikura really turned over a new leaf? And will Momose keep the secret about his rowdy past?

items.description_es: Momose siempre ha anhelado una vida pacífica en la escuela secundaria. No quiere tener nada que ver con matones, delincuentes o alborotadores. Cuando conoce a Ichikura, un discreto chico de pelo negro con gafas, parece un chico normal y agradable. ¡Pero resulta que en la secundaria él era un delincuente nefasto! Él sigue asegurándole que ha cambiado sus costumbres, ¡pero todavía tiene una habilidad especial para buscar peleas! ¿Ichikura realmente ha pasado página? ¿Y Momose guardará el secreto de su ruidoso pasado?

items.title: Majo to Youhei
items.description: Nothing in this world is more dangerous than a witch. The epitome of fear and terror, they can summon floods on a whim, conjure balls of fire out of the air, or even destroy entire countries overnight. Incur their wrath, and no one is safe. At least, that’s what everyone thinks, and it’s the very reason they all want Siasha dead. After yet another violent battle for her life, she teams up with Zig, a mercenary, and they depart for unknown lands to find somewhere she can live in peace. But is the pair any match for the lost magic and vicious monstrosities that lie ahead?
items.title_japanese: 魔女と傭兵
items.description_es: Nada en este mundo es más peligroso que una bruja. Son el epítome del miedo y el terror y pueden provocar inundaciones a su antojo, conjurar bolas de fuego en el aire o incluso destruir países enteros de la noche a la mañana. Incurre en su ira y nadie estará a salvo. Al menos eso es lo que todo el mundo piensa, y es la razón por la que todos quieren muerta a Siasha. Después de otra violenta batalla por su vida, se une a Zig, un mercenario, y parten hacia tierras desconocidas para encontrar un lugar donde pueda vivir en paz. Pero, ¿podrá la pareja hacer frente a la magia perdida y las feroces monstruosidades que se avecinan?

items.title: LONA
items.description: A broken world in the not-so distant future. Humanity is facing a new incident. "We’re being attacked by humans who should be dead." The government has decided to request a specialized organization to deal with this situation. The Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis, commonly known as "LONA." Researcher Ao and her apprentice Sango will try to get to the bottom of the mystery by analyzing the brains of the dead. What do people think of, and what do they leave behind before they die? Countless memories engraved in the neural circuits. What did they see in those deep depths?
items.title_japanese: LONA
title_synonyms: Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis
search_titles: Laboratory of Optics and Neural Analysis
items.description_es: Un mundo roto en un futuro no muy lejano. La humanidad se enfrenta a un nuevo incidente. "Estamos siendo atacados por humanos que deberían estar muertos". El gobierno ha decidido solicitar una organización especializada para hacer frente a esta situación. El Laboratorio de Óptica y Análisis Neural, comúnmente conocido como “LONA”. La investigadora Ao y su aprendiz Sango intentarán llegar al fondo del misterio analizando los cerebros de los muertos. ¿Qué piensa la gente y qué deja atrás antes de morir? Innumerables recuerdos grabados en los circuitos neuronales. ¿Qué vieron en esas profundidades?

items.title: Houkago Kitaku Biyori
items.description: During his time in middle school, Shun was a well-known soccer player, but an injury sidelined him, making it impossible not only to play soccer but also to engage in any physical activity. Upon entering high school, he grew weary of continually turning down invitations to various clubs. Frustrated, he absentmindedly expressed his desire to just go home one day. Hearing this, a girl named Naoki invited him to join the "Hyper Go-Home Club". They ended up gradually walking home together, and the romantic comedy unfolds.
items.title_japanese: 放課後帰宅びより

items.title: Biblia Koshodou no Jiken Techou
items.description: Biblia Koshodou no Jiken Techou is a mystery series where Shinokawa Shioriko, a young owner of a bookstore in Kamakura, unravel mysteries of ancient books that are taken there. The story begins with a young man named Daisuke, who grew up practically without reading books due to a "phobia," brings the complete (and autographed) works of Natsume Soseki, Japanese writer of the Meiji era, inherited from his grandmother in the mysterious bookstore. Will the shy and introvert Shioriko solve the mystery of the books?

title_synonyms: The Case Files of Biblia Bookstore

items.title: Unmei no Makimodoshi
items.description: The series follows Chrono, a 14-year-old boy who is a member of the Space-Time Police Special Forces Unit called the “Rewinders”. The organization uses its “Retry Eye” to save people who have already died, using future knowledge to repeatedly go back in time to get to a future where the victim is alive and well.
items.title_japanese: 運命の巻戻士
title_synonyms: Fate Rewinder: All Great Achievements Require Time
search_titles: Fate Rewinder: All Great Achievements Require Time
items.description_es: La serie sigue a Chrono, un niño de 14 años que es miembro de la Unidad de Fuerzas Especiales de la Policía del Espacio-Tiempo llamada "Rewinders". La organización utiliza su “Retry Eye” para salvar a personas que ya han muerto, utilizando conocimientos futuros para retroceder repetidamente en el tiempo y llegar a un futuro en el que la víctima esté viva y bien.

items.title: Otome Game no Heroine de Saikyou Survival
items.description: Orphaned by a monster attack on her village, young Alicia spends three horrid years in an orphanage before finally running away. When she flees, however, Alicia has a violent encounter with an older woman hell-bent on killing her. During their tussle, she comes into contact with a strange crystal that bestows upon her a wealth of knowledge, transforming her from an innocent child into a cool and calculated planner. Now aware that she was meant to be the protagonist of an otome game and disgusted with her supposed fate, Alicia decides to take matters into her own hands and become strong—by any means necessary. Using her newfound knowledge, and with some help from a stranger she meets in the woods, she learns to survive by herself in a world far too harsh and unforgiving for a girl her age. Ready or not, she’s determined to carve her own path.
